context_capacity_catalog.rounding_note: Where a source states K/M without defining the unit, decimal Token values are used conservatively. A zero hard-limit field means unknown or no separately documented hard limit.

presets.name: 火山方舟 Ark（按量 API，北京）
presets.display_hint: 北京按量 API。需普通 Ark 密钥并开通模型；调用可能单独计费。
presets.notes: Beijing pay-as-you-go endpoint. Requires normal Ark API key and model activation/permissions. Model IDs with date versions differ from Agent/Coding Plan model names. ep-* custom deployment IDs may be entered manually when owned/authorized; do not invent them.

presets.name: 火山方舟 Ark Agent Plan（套餐）
presets.display_hint: Agent Plan 套餐端点，需专用密钥；模型权限随套餐等级变化。自建应用资格未确认，候选验证可能计费。
presets.notes: Current official /api/plan/v3 is Agent Plan, not a deprecated alias for /api/coding/v3. Dedicated Agent Plan API key required. Small/Medium/Large/Max have different entitlements; Kimi K3 is documented for Medium and above. Preserve an existing /api/plan/v3 configuration. Official guides support OpenClaw, Hermes and research Agent tools.; Whether an arbitrary custom optical assistant or automated candidate probe is an allowed Agent Plan application was not conclusively verified. Do not transfer the Coding Plan-only restriction onto Agent Plan as fact, but do not claim blanket eligibility or automatically probe subscription candidates.

presets.name: 火山方舟 Ark Coding Plan（限指定用途）
presets.display_hint: Coding Plan 专供指定 AI 编程工具；额度不可用于普通自建应用，此项不可选。
presets.notes: Coding Plan subscription and corresponding key required. /api/v3 is pay-as-you-go and can incur extra charges instead of consuming the Coding Plan allowance. Personal and enterprise documentation can differ in available model set.; Official documentation limits quota to AI coding tools and warns other use may suspend the subscription or account. This should not be offered as a ready-to-use general application backend preset.

presets.name: DeepSeek（官方 API）
presets.display_hint: OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions；模型权限按账户开通情况决定，按服务商规则计费。
presets.notes: Both models support thinking/non-thinking modes. deepseek-flash is the current API ID for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; do not construct deepseek-v4.1 or deepseek4.1 as API IDs.

presets.name: 阿里云百炼 DashScope（北京，按量）
presets.display_hint: 中国区按量 API，密钥按地域区分；生产工作空间 URL 需填入实际工作空间 ID。
presets.notes: API keys are region-specific. Shared DashScope domain remains available; official docs recommend the workspace domain https://{WorkspaceId}.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 for production. Never write a literal placeholder as a runnable URL without the workspace ID. Pay-as-you-go key is distinct from plan key.

presets.name: 阿里云 Model Studio（新加坡，按量）
presets.display_hint: 新加坡区按量 API，需国际区密钥与工作空间地址；权限不跨区域通用。
presets.notes: Singapore-region API key required. Workspace production URL is https://{WorkspaceId}.ap-southeast-1.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1. Region and service-deployment scope affect availability; do not assume China keys or model entitlements transfer.

presets.name: 阿里云百炼 Coding Plan（中国，限指定用途）
presets.display_hint: 中国区 Coding Plan 限指定交互式编程工具；自建后端与脚本不可用，此项不可选。
presets.notes: Dedicated sk-sp- plan key and plan URL must be paired. Current docs list exact supported versions; do not import newer pay-as-you-go or upstream provider IDs. Lite no longer available for new purchase/renewal; remaining subscriptions valid until expiration.; Official docs restrict use to interactive coding tools/OpenClaw-type Agents and disallow automated scripts, custom application backends and non-interactive batch use.

presets.name: Alibaba Cloud Coding Plan（国际，限指定用途）
presets.display_hint: 国际 Coding Plan 仅限支持的交互式编程工具；需专用密钥，不可用于自建后端。
presets.notes: International subscription and dedicated sk-sp- key. Official international Coding Plan overview was updated 2026-09-28. It independently confirms these model IDs and endpoints; this is not inferred from the China plan.; Interactive use in supported programming tools; automated scripts, application backends and non-interactive batch use prohibited by provider docs.

presets.name: 智谱 BigModel（标准 API）
presets.display_hint: 中国区标准 API；与 GLM Coding Plan 使用不同端点和额度。
presets.notes: Mainland BigModel standard API. Do not confuse with international Z.ai, Coding Plan endpoint or Coding Plan allowance. Shared Anthropic endpoint is documented; billing/eligibility depends on key and context, so default OpenAI path keeps standard-vs-Coding distinction explicit.

presets.name: 智谱 GLM Coding Plan（限指定工具）
presets.display_hint: Coding Plan 仅限官方支持工具；自建应用按标准 API 计费，此项不可选。
presets.notes: All current plan tiers support GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash. GLM-5.2/5.1 automatically switch to 5.3; GLM-5-Turbo/4.7 switch to 5.3-Flash in the Coding Plan. Team plan key is distinct from other platform keys.; Only officially supported tools and product environments qualify for Coding Plan quota. Official FAQ directs self-built applications, websites, bots and SaaS to standard API billing.

presets.name: Moonshot / Kimi（中国 API）
presets.display_hint: 中国区 API，需中国区平台密钥；K3、K2.7-Code 的采样参数受限。
presets.notes: platform.kimi.com China API key; not interchangeable with platform.kimi.ai international key. Account tier controls access. Kimi Code subscription is not assumed equivalent to the open API account.; K3 always reasons and uses reasoning_effort low/high/max. Do not pass generic adjustable temperature defaults: K3 and K2.7-Code fix temperature=1 and top_p=0.95. A 400 caused by invalid sampling options must not mark model ID unavailable.

presets.name: Moonshot / Kimi（国际 API）
presets.display_hint: 国际 API，需国际区平台密钥；与中国区账户和密钥不通用。
presets.notes: platform.kimi.ai international API account. China and international keys cannot be mixed; candidate set remains subject to account tier and model-list result.

presets.name: MiniMax（中国 API）
presets.display_hint: 中国区 API，需中国区平台账户；M Plan 与 Token Plan 权益不同，不自动迁移旧地址。
presets.notes: Current official Chinese docs use api.minimax.cn. Legacy platform.minimaxi.com docs redirect to platform.minimax.cn. M Plan/Token Plan are different billing entitlements; no automatic migration of an existing minimaxi URL is justified merely by this catalog.

presets.name: MiniMax（国际 API）
presets.display_hint: 国际 API，需国际区平台账户；地区和密钥不与中国区互通。
presets.notes: International platform.minimax.io account; Chinese and international preset hosts are separate. Both OpenAI and Anthropic-compatible API formats are officially documented.

presets.name: 硅基流动 SiliconFlow（中国）
presets.display_hint: 中国区聚合推理服务；模型 ID 区分大小写，部分模型需实名或权限。
presets.notes: Official infrastructure/model service provider. Full organization prefix and case are part of each ID. Provider catalog is not upstream provider catalog; DeepSeek upstream retirement does not establish SiliconFlow retirement. Real-name authentication or account permission may be required for some models.

presets.name: OpenAI
presets.display_hint: GPT-6 Astra / 6.1 Sol 工具调用需 Responses；GPT-6 Luna 仅关闭推理时可用 Chat 函数工具。
presets.notes: 协议说明核验日期：2026-10-12。仅针对此官方端点与精确模型 ID：GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 可用 Chat Completions 做无工具请求，函数工具调用需 Responses；GPT-6 Luna 的 Chat 函数工具仅 reasoning_effort=none，推理加工具需 Responses。供应商内建工具另有 Responses 要求，不能据此推断其他模型、聚合器或兼容服务的普通函数工具也需 Responses。推理非 none 时不能照搬 temperature/top_p/logprobs 参数。目录能力不代表账号权限或真实端点验收；本应用实际支持范围以助手协议契约和请求前检查为准。

presets.name: Anthropic / Claude
presets.display_hint: Anthropic OpenAI 兼容入口（非原生 Messages）；工具、缓存、音频等功能受限，本应用不适配原生 Messages。
presets.notes: 原生 Messages 的请求体、系统提示、工具与流式事件不同于 OpenAI；不可只改 URL 假装完成适配。; 官方兼容层另行存在，定位测试比较；strict、prompt caching、audio 等存在限制或忽略字段。生产功能优先原生 Messages。; Models API 可返回 capabilities、token limits、line；不应仅靠 ID 字符串猜能力或分组。

presets.name: Google Gemini (Developer API)
presets.display_hint: Gemini Developer API 兼容入口（非 Vertex AI）；预览模型与原生接口能力有差异。
presets.notes: 本项是 Gemini Developer API，不是 Vertex AI。; 官方兼容入口支持 models.list，但并非原生 generateContent 的请求体。; 2.5 系列官方当前限制为此前活跃使用者；不应作为新用户通用默认。Preview 需标注。

presets.name: xAI / Grok
presets.display_hint: 全球默认区域 Chat Completions；区域模型不同，新功能优先 Responses。
presets.notes: OpenAI SDK 的 Chat Completions / Responses 均有官方入口；新集成优先 Responses。; 全球默认地址与 US 区域地址分开；区域模型集合不同，本项不切换到 US 区域。; grok-3、grok-4-0709、grok-4-1-fast-* 等旧 slug 已发生退休重定向，不作为当前独立模型种子。

presets.name: Mistral AI
presets.display_hint: OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions；Large 4 为公开预览，Small 4 的 API ID 为 mistral-small-2603。
presets.notes: 官方迁移指南明确支持 OpenAI-compatible client。; Small 4 的 ID 是 mistral-small-2603，不是照展示名推断出的 mistral-small-4。; Large 4 于官方页标 Public Preview；不将它标成 GA。

presets.name: Groq
presets.display_hint: 托管推理 API；Preview/Enterprise 模型可能有权限限制，部分 OpenAI 参数不支持。
presets.notes: Groq 是推理服务商，GPT-OSS/Qwen/Llama 的模型作者不是 Groq。; Enterprise 条目不应宣称普通 key 可用；Preview 不保证生产稳定性。; 兼容层有不支持的字段；勿发送未验证的 logprobs、logit_bias、top_logprobs、messages[].name 或 n>1。

presets.name: OpenRouter (聚合服务)
presets.display_hint: 模型聚合与路由服务，使用 OpenRouter 账户和计费；上游可用性、区域与参数支持各异。
presets.notes: 聚合服务，不是这些模型的原厂直连；使用 OpenRouter key、计费与路由。; 保留完整 provider/model ID；不能把 Anthropic 原厂 claude-opus-5-5 拼成 OpenRouter ID，OpenRouter 此项使用 claude-opus-5.5。; 目录只证明平台文档列出模型；具体可路由上游、地区、权限与 supported_parameters 需按发现结果判断。
